decisions.rationale: ROOT independently reproduced that the candidate admits LoRa spreading_factor_min values 1 and 6 under the delegated minimum 7, while it rejects the valid narrowed minimum 8. This reverses lower-bound narrowing at the signed physical-dispatch scope boundary. The problem is an explicit RF authority expansion; the correction is a localized predicate plus one focused host-only regression.
decisions.smallest_fix: Treat spreading_factor_min as a delegated lower bound, retain spreading_factor_max as an upper bound, and require the effective minimum not to exceed the effective maximum. Preserve all fixed/equality and other maximum rules.
